weather.narration.severe: The crews say Saltha is hungry tonight. The steersmen say nothing at all and keep the bows to the seas.
weather.narration.severeSheltered: Under the cliffs the men lash the ships to anything that will hold and listen to the sea trying to take them. By morning the old hands are saying the offerings were not wasted.
weather.narration.fleetLost: The sea took them in {zone}. The skalds will sing the names, because there is nothing else to bury.
